# Compute v2

<!-- Generated by sdkgen; edit internal/cmd/sdkgen/service_docs.go. -->

Use Gophercloud v2.15.0's compute/v2 API through one authenticated service object. Connection manages authentication, region, endpoint interface and TLS.

Service access: `conn.ComputeV2(ctx)` (openstacksdk: `conn.compute`).

Package docs describe the service and its resources (`go doc ./compute/v2/...`). [Wait policies](../../docs/service-waits.md), [identity finding](../../docs/finding-identities.md), [project quotas](quotasets/README.md), [limits](limits/README.md), [server tags](tags/README.md) and [instance actions](instanceactions/README.md) cover shared behavior.

## Go usage

```go
// Inside a function with context.Context ctx and *openstack.Connection conn.
service, err := conn.ComputeV2(ctx)
if err != nil { return err }
for value, err := range service.Servers.Resources.List(ctx) {
    if err != nil { return err }
    fmt.Println(value)
}
value, err := service.Servers.Find(ctx, resource.Name("example"))
if err != nil { return err }
_ = value
```

Examples use `fmt` and `github.com/JSYoo5B/go-openstacksdk/resource`.
